    def test_add_forbids_recurrence_id(submission_command: tuple[str, ...], tmp_path: Path) -> None:
        # RFC 5546 §3.2.4 marks RECURRENCE-ID presence 0. Supply all required
        # properties so only this row can account for the named warning.
        body = (
            "UID:e1\nDTSTAMP:20260101T120000Z\nDTSTART:20260305T100000Z\n"
            "SEQUENCE:1\nSUMMARY:Added instance\n"
            "ORGANIZER:mailto:boss@example.com\n"
            "RECURRENCE-ID:20260305T100000Z\n"
        )
        out = run_parse(submission_command, _wrap("ADD", body), tmp_path)
        # The public warning schema (tech-reqs "Warning schema") requires
        # method/component metadata, but its property-name list omits
        # RECURRENCE-ID. Score the sole invalid ADD row without inventing an
        # enumeration extension; retain exact property checks on other cases.
        warnings = cast(list[dict[str, Any]], out.get("warnings") or [])
>       assert any(

submission_command = ('/tmp/pytest-of-root/pytest-0/ical-build0/build/release/ical',)
tmp_path = PosixPath('/tmp/pytest-of-root/pytest-0/test_exdate_removes_before_ove0')

    def test_exdate_removes_before_override_replaces(
        submission_command: tuple[str, ...], tmp_path: Path
    ) -> None:
        # A recurrence-id that overrides a specific instance that is ALSO on the
        # EXDATE list: EXDATE wins (the instance is not produced, so there's
        # nothing to override). The override is therefore orphan.
        ics = (
            "BEGIN:VCALENDAR\nVERSION:2.0\nPRODID:-//T//EN\n"
            "BEGIN:VEVENT\n"
            "UID:e1\nDTSTAMP:20260101T120000Z\nDTSTART:20260305T100000Z\n"
            "RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=5\n"
            "EXDATE:20260307T100000Z\n"
            "END:VEVENT\n"
            "BEGIN:VEVENT\n"
            "UID:e1\nDTSTAMP:20260101T120000Z\n"
            "RECURRENCE-ID:20260307T100000Z\nDTSTART:20260307T150000Z\n"
            "END:VEVENT\n"
            "END:VCALENDAR\n"
        )
        out = run_expand(
            submission_command, ics, "2026-03-01T00:00:00Z", "2026-03-15T00:00:00Z", tmp_path
        )
        # The 3/7 10:00 base instance was EXDATE'd, so the override should become
        # an orphan_override warning. It's still surfaced as an occurrence.
        kinds = [w.get("kind") for w in warnings_of(out)]
>       assert "orphan_override" in kinds
E       AssertionError: assert 'orphan_override' in []

review.notes:
Tests-only ICal 3.0.5 regrade of unchanged preserved gpt-6-astra Max ical-rs source. Previous3.0.4 and corrected3.0.5 both score 465/467, with zero errors/skips. All461 unaffected and all6 changed-case outcomes are identical. Five CANCEL fixtures now carry an incremented sequence; STATUS and missing-SEQUENCE negatives isolate their named public diagnostic, and the latter names an affected attendee. The unchanged reference passes467/467. A strict sequence control improves3/6 to6/6; three negative controls retain one intended failure each despite an unrelated warning. Independent authority/patch/control review approves these corrections. All28 public-input hashes and reference code remain unchanged. Remaining failed nodes: test_itip_methods_deep.py::test_add_forbids_recurrence_id; test_library_divergence.py::test_exdate_removes_before_override_replaces. Failed observations are not independent defect counts. Prior generation/source/transcript reviews remain applicable and their full publication payloads and linked history are retained. Root verified sequential pinned-image regrading, complete original source/result preservation, and identical usage/cohort. Tool counts remain as independently audited; unknown counts remain unavailable. Reasoning is included within output tokens. API-equivalent estimates are not subscription charges; this regrade makes zero model calls and adds zero generation cost.

editorial.last_message: Claims implemented; scores 465/467 under ICal 3.0.4. Release build, 10 Rust tests and 31 CLI checks are corroborated; ADD prohibition and orphan-override warnings remain incomplete.
editorial.notes:
Tests-only ICal 3.0.4 regrade of unchanged preserved gpt-6-astra Max ical-rs source. The preceding 3.0.3 publication and current grade both score 465/467, without skips or errors. All 460 unaffected outcomes and all seven changed-case outcomes are identical for this source; two renamed cases are explicitly mapped. Three invalid component-free positive fixtures now contain a valid VTIMEZONE or VEVENT. Orphan diagnostics may appear during parse or bounded expand, without requiring todo/journal occurrence output; missing both still fails. The isolated ADD prohibition requires kind/method/component while avoiding the ambiguous unlisted RECURRENCE-ID property metadata value. These changes leave all 28 assembled model inputs and reference code unchanged. The unchanged reference passes 467/467. A combined permitted-policy control changes from 0/7 on prior tests to 7/7; four independent negative controls retain their exact intended failures without schema amplification. Independent author, authority and patch/control reviews checked the correction; root verified sequential pinned-image regrading and preservation. Remaining failed nodes: test_itip_methods_deep.py::test_add_forbids_recurrence_id; test_library_divergence.py::test_exdate_removes_before_override_replaces. Failure observations are not independent bug counts. Earlier source/transcript/final-claim reviews remain applicable to the unchanged generation; their complete publication payloads and linked audit history remain preserved. The 3.0.3 cancellation/alarm correction remains in force. Original metadata, raw score, source/transcript/session hashes and input/output/cache/reasoning usage are retained. Tool-call accounting is rechecked from preserved evidence; unavailable counts remain unavailable. Reasoning is an output subset and is not charged twice. The retained API-equivalent estimate is not a subscription charge. Regrading makes no model calls and adds no generation cost.
